title: Post-overseer follow-up: network safety and publish governance hardening
description: Follow-up findings from the second overseer review on main commit 7f10e8c. Scope covers verified gaps in SSRF non-global IP handling, artifact URL error contracts, release evidence validity, release-path enforcement, alternate CI parity, CLI metadata parity, service lifecycle cancellation, capabilities contract drift, and BOM consistency.
acceptance_criteria: All child findings are remediated with TDD/BDD acceptance tests; quality gate passes; roadmap traceability maps every capability, epic, feature, task, and function; Beads export and remote sync complete.

title: Drain or cancel active evaluation jobs on service shutdown
description: Finding: EvaluationJobStore launches jobs with queueMicrotask; StartedService.close only closes HTTP server; persistence stores terminal jobs only, so in-flight work can outlive close or disappear on restart.
acceptance_criteria: EvaluationJobStore tracks active jobs and exposes close/drain with timeout and/or AbortSignal; StartedService.close awaits or cancels active work; recovered non-terminal jobs become explicit interrupted/failed or are resumable; tests cover close while a job is running and restart after non-terminal state.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD; oversized JSON, artifact status gate, symlink escape, and shutdown interruption tests pass; quality gate passes.

title: Reject artifact symlink escapes before streaming files
description: Finding: ArtifactStore.open checks resolved path string but uses statSync/createReadStream, which follow symlinks; a symlink under an evaluation artifact directory can stream a target outside artifactRoot.
acceptance_criteria: ArtifactStore rejects symlinks with lstat or equivalent; realpath of opened file and evaluation directory are checked to remain under artifactRoot; tests cover symlink escape, regular file success, basename traversal, and encoded traversal.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD; oversized JSON, artifact status gate, symlink escape, and shutdown interruption tests pass; quality gate passes.

title: Gate direct artifact downloads by terminal job status
description: Finding: artifact manifest returns 409 unless job status is succeeded, but direct GET /evaluations/{id}/artifacts/{name} only checks that the job exists before streaming a file.
acceptance_criteria: Direct artifact download applies the same succeeded-only gate as manifest/result; pending/running/failed jobs return 409 result_not_ready; tests cover pending and failed jobs with preexisting artifact files.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD; oversized JSON, artifact status gate, symlink escape, and shutdown interruption tests pass; quality gate passes.

title: Bound JSON request bodies and request lifetime
description: Finding: readJsonBody collects all chunks with no byte cap, timeout, or early destroy; /evaluations and /recon call it before validation.
acceptance_criteria: readJsonBody enforces a small configurable JSON body cap; oversized payloads return 413 with stable JSON error; over-limit requests stop reading/destroy safely; request timeout behavior is defined; tests cover oversized /evaluations and /recon payloads.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD; oversized JSON, artifact status gate, symlink escape, and shutdown interruption tests pass; quality gate passes.

title: BDD/TDD: add release security compliance and SBOM gate
description: Capability: release security evidence. BDD: Given release validation runs, when audit, secret scan, SBOM, pack dry-run, and artifact hygiene checks execute, then release blockers fail with actionable output and non-blocking manual gates are explicit. TDD: add tests for release validation helper before wiring docs and release script.
acceptance_criteria: Release checklist maps every quality, audit, secret, SBOM, pack, and artifact hygiene gate to a command, artifact, or manual decision; helper tests run without network dependency; docs record generated evidence paths.
close_reason: Release security compliance and SBOM gate added. Implemented no-network tools/check-release-security.js with tests, added release:security:check script, mapped checklist/BOM evidence paths for SBOM, secret scan, prod audit, pack dry-run, quality, CodeQL, artifact hygiene, and manual decisions. Validation: node tools/check-release-security.js passed; node --test tests/release-security.test.js passed; pnpm run quality:check passed with coverage line 85.97%, branch 78.04%, function 75.07%.

title: BDD/TDD: enforce package tarball boundary and BOM evidence
description: Capability: deterministic npm package boundary. BDD: Given pnpm pack --dry-run, when package contents are inspected, then only approved runtime files, bins, docs, license, security, and metadata are included. TDD: add package-boundary test or helper before updating BOM evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Package boundary test verifies package.json files/bin and dry-run contents; tests, temp dirs, local configs, and build cache artifacts are excluded; docs/bill-of-materials.html.md matches actual package evidence.
notes: TDD harness checkpoint: tests/package-boundary.test.js and tools/check-package-boundary.js added. RED verified missing helper; GREEN focused package-boundary test passed 2/2; full pnpm run quality:check passed. Keep open until docs/bill-of-materials.html.md is updated to match actual package evidence.
close_reason: Package tarball boundary and BOM evidence updated. Added package-boundary coverage for service runtime files and disallowed dist/.tsbuildinfo, updated BOM with HTTP service runtime modules/endpoints/security controls and latest pnpm pack --dry-run evidence. Validation: pnpm pack --dry-run passed; pnpm run build && node --test tests/package-boundary.test.js passed; pnpm run quality:check passed with coverage line 86.25%, branch 78.45%, function 75.69%.

title: BDD/TDD: smoke-test documented commands and examples
description: Capability: executable user guidance. BDD: Given README, CLI guide, and release process examples, when docs-command smoke tests run, then supported commands exist and documented output or artifact claims match actual behavior. TDD: add failing docs command smoke tests before final docs edits.
acceptance_criteria: tests/docs-command-smoke.test.js or equivalent covers supported CLI/service/release examples; docs mark networked or destructive commands as manual gates; docs describe only implemented behavior.
notes: TDD harness checkpoint: tests/docs-command-smoke.test.js and tools/check-docs-commands.js added. RED verified missing helper; GREEN focused test passed 3/3; full pnpm run quality:check passed. Keep open until dod.3 docs alignment lands and supported examples/manual gates are finalized.
close_reason: Documented command smoke gate finalized. Added docs-command smoke coverage for service command/endpoints and enforced manual gates across real README/CLI/release docs so networked/destructive examples are explicitly marked. Validation: pnpm run build && node --test tests/docs-command-smoke.test.js passed; pnpm run quality:check passed with coverage line 86.25%, branch 78.45%, function 75.69%.

title: BDD/TDD: align docs with executable CLI and service behavior
description: Capability: finished-product user guidance. BDD: Given the README, CLI guide, release process, and examples, when a user follows documented commands, then each command exists and produces described outputs. TDD: add docs-command smoke tests for CLI examples, service examples, env configuration, artifact paths, and release checklist commands before final doc updates.
acceptance_criteria: Docs only describe implemented behavior; command examples are smoke-tested; release checklist includes quality, coverage, pack dry-run, audit, and artifact hygiene gates.
close_reason: Docs aligned with executable CLI and service behavior. Updated README and CLI runbook for serve command, health/capabilities, evaluations, artifacts, recon, auth token behavior, traversal rejection, persistence/recovery semantics, and added docs smoke assertions for the service command/endpoints. Validation: pnpm run build && node --test tests/docs-command-smoke.test.js passed; pnpm run quality:check passed with coverage line 86.25%, branch 78.45%, function 75.69%.

title: BDD/TDD: replace dynamic eval import wrappers
description: Capability: maintainable dependency loading. BDD: Given optional runtime dependencies such as playwright-core, when modules load, then standard dynamic import paths work without eval-style Function wrappers and produce actionable missing-dependency errors. TDD: add failing tests that scan built/source modules for new Function import wrappers and verify missing dependency messaging before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: No dynamic eval import wrappers remain in source; optional dependency behavior stays clear and tested; bundler/static-analysis compatibility improves.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD on feature/bdd-tdd-product-backlog: timezone-aware PageSpeed parsing fixtures now pass; dynamic eval import wrappers replaced and guarded by tsconfig compatibility test.

title: BDD/TDD: support timezone-aware PageSpeed date metrics
description: Capability: international audit correctness. BDD: Given PageSpeed or GEO/AEO metric payloads containing timezone-aware or localized date strings, when summaries are parsed, then scores and freshness calculations are stable across timezones. TDD: add failing schema/parser tests with UTC offsets, localized strings, missing timezone data, and daylight-saving boundary fixtures before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Timezone-aware fixtures parse deterministically; invalid localized dates fail or degrade with explicit diagnostics; existing PageSpeed summary tests still pass.
notes: TDD RED: added PageSpeed localized metric/timezone fixtures in tests/pagespeed-service.test.js; they failed because lcpMs/parseErrors/fetchedAt were undefined. GREEN: added fallback localized displayValue parsing, UTC fetchTime normalization, parseErrors, schema fields; verified non-incremental build plus node --test tests/pagespeed-service.test.js tests/db-schemas.test.js.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD on feature/bdd-tdd-product-backlog: timezone-aware PageSpeed parsing fixtures now pass; dynamic eval import wrappers replaced and guarded by tsconfig compatibility test.

title: Phase 3: docs and release-readiness validation
description: Update docs to reflect actual behavior and run release-grade validation matrix.
close_reason: Phase 3 docs and release-readiness validation complete. Child BDD/TDD slices dod.1-dod.6 are closed, including executable docs, command smoke/manual gates, package/BOM boundary evidence, and release security/SBOM gate. Validation: latest main checkpoint a2c8175 passed CI run 27119027268 and CodeQL run 27119027098; final local quality:check passed with coverage line 85.97%, branch 78.04%, function 75.07%.

title: Update BOM install-policy section to match no-preinstall posture
description: Finding OSR2-F09: docs/bill-of-materials.html.md still says preinstall rejects non-pnpm installs, but package.json intentionally has no preinstall hook and tests assert npm global install is not blocked.
acceptance_criteria: BOM states current policy accurately: packageManager pins pnpm for repo work, .npmrc controls local script shell/package-manager behavior, and no preinstall hook blocks npm global install; docs consistency tests cover the updated posture.
close_reason: BOM install-policy text now documents no preinstall hook blocks npm global install while pnpm remains required for repo development and CI.

title: Keep CLI version output in sync with package metadata
description: Finding OSR2-F02: package.json version is 3.0.11, but Commander is hard-coded to version 2.0.0 and node dist/cli.js --version reports stale metadata.
acceptance_criteria: CLI --version matches package.json version; a CLI contract test fails on drift; implementation avoids duplicating version literals where practical.
close_reason: CLI --version now loads package metadata at runtime and contract coverage asserts dist output matches package.json.

title: Align or retire stale non-GitHub CI configs
description: Finding OSR2-F08: GitHub Actions is aligned to Node 24/pnpm, but .gitlab-ci.yml and bitbucket-pipelines.yml still use Node 20 and npm ci despite package engines requiring Node >=24 and pnpm@11.4.0.
acceptance_criteria: Every active CI config uses Node 24+, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, and equivalent quality/security gates as the maintained GitHub workflow; inactive alternate CI configs are removed or documented as intentionally unsupported; tests or docs checks prevent drift.
close_reason: Alternate GitLab and Bitbucket CI configs now use Node 24, pinned pnpm via corepack, frozen installs, and no npm ci path.

title: Enforce release security gate in production release path
description: Finding OSR2-F07: per-commit CI intentionally treats release:security:check as manual/local-only, but tools/release.sh runs only quality:check before release-it. A release owner can create tags/GitHub releases without the evidence gate running in the production release wrapper.
acceptance_criteria: tools/release.sh runs pnpm run release:security:check before release-it, or requires a machine-verifiable checked evidence bundle; tests assert production release wiring; release:dry may remain manual but must exercise the same pre-release gate in dry-run mode.
close_reason: Release wrapper now runs release:security:check after quality checks and before release-it with ordering coverage.

title: Deduplicate service capabilities engine and format contracts
description: Finding OSR2-F05: /capabilities hard-codes engine and format literals separately from runtime config schemas, creating drift risk when engines or report formats change.
acceptance_criteria: Engines and formats returned by /capabilities derive from one shared contract module or exported schemas; service and tests consume that source; adding a runtime engine/format fails a focused contract test if capabilities drift.
close_reason: Capabilities now derive engine and report format arrays from exported config schema constants with drift coverage.

title: Feature: align package metadata and publish documentation
description: Metadata and documentation consistency follow-up findings from the second overseer review. Covers stale CLI version reporting and BOM install-policy drift.
acceptance_criteria: CLI version output matches package metadata with a regression test; BOM and publish docs accurately describe package-manager policy and npm global-install posture.

title: Externalize package-boundary policy from validator code
description: Finding: expected package files and bin policy are hard-coded constants in check-package-boundary.js, making legitimate publish-surface changes require code edits and increasing coupling.
acceptance_criteria: Package-boundary policy is data-driven or derived from a versioned manifest; tests cover allowed additions separately from prohibited artifacts; validatePackageBoundary remains closed to policy-extension code churn.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD; release policy, external package-boundary policy, and health recovery redaction tests pass; quality gate passes.

title: Validate release script semantics, not just script presence
description: Finding: validateReleaseSecurityGate only checks required script keys exist; audit:signatures currently maps to pnpm audit while checklist expects pnpm audit --prod semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Release security gate validates exact required command semantics or documented acceptable equivalents for audit, pack, and release dry-run scripts; tests fail when scripts point to placeholders or wrong command variants.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD; release policy, external package-boundary policy, and health recovery redaction tests pass; quality gate passes.

title: Redact unauthenticated recovery details from health
description: Finding: /health is intentionally unauthenticated and includes raw recovery error messages from job-state load failures.
acceptance_criteria: Public health remains minimal but omits raw recovery exception details; authenticated callers can retrieve detailed recovery diagnostics or logs through an explicit path; tests update token-mode health expectations and degraded-state behavior.
close_reason: Implemented with TDD; release policy, external package-boundary policy, and health recovery redaction tests pass; quality gate passes.
